description: 146,381,550 building footprints (structures over 450 sq ft) for the 50 states, DC and five territories, from the FEMA/ORNL USA Structures state File Geodatabases in `fema-usa-structures/raw`, merged into one GeoParquet 1.1 file. Attributes include occupancy class, address, height, area, adjacent ground elevation and estimated population. Rows are Hilbert-sorted within each state and carry a `bbox` covering column, so bbox filters in DuckDB, GeoPandas and GDAL skip row groups outside the query. Built by `fema-usa-structures/scripts/build_geoparquet.py`.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Area of feature in internal units squared.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Length of feature in internal units.

table:columns.name: BUILD_ID
table:columns.description: Unique ID for each feature.

table:columns.name: OCC_CLS
table:columns.description: This identifies the top level building occupancy class as defined by Locations: Building Occupancy Classification; FEMA Data Standard; July 31, 2018.

table:columns.name: PRIM_OCC
table:columns.description: This identifies the primary descriptor for a building's usage for each top level building occupancy class as defined by Locations: Building Occupancy Classification; FEMA Data Standard; July 31, 2018.

table:columns.name: SEC_OCC
table:columns.description: This describes the range of units within Multi Family Dwelling and Temporary Lodging descriptors for Residential building occupancy class as defined by Locations: Building Occupancy Classification; FEMA Data Standard; July 31, 2018.

table:columns.name: PROP_ADDR
table:columns.description: Primary street address for a structure (i.e. 5th Avenue and Main Street).

table:columns.name: PROP_CITY
table:columns.description: City name.

table:columns.name: PROP_ST
table:columns.description: State name.

table:columns.name: PROP_ZIP
table:columns.description: Zip code (5 digit).

table:columns.name: PROP_CNTY
table:columns.description: County Name.

table:columns.name: OUTBLDG
table:columns.description: A non-primary structure or outbuilding such as a garage, shed or other accessory building.

table:columns.name: HEIGHT
table:columns.description: This is a measure of the height (in meters) of the structure as determined from LiDAR or other source data.

table:columns.name: SQMETERS
table:columns.description: This is the two-dimensional area of the building in square meters.

table:columns.name: SQFEET
table:columns.description: This is the two-dimensional area of the building in square feet.

table:columns.name: H_ADJ_ELEV
table:columns.description: This is the highest elevation (in meters) of the ground adjacent to the structure as estimated from available elevation data.

table:columns.name: L_ADJ_ELEV
table:columns.description: This is the lowest elevation (in meters) of the ground adjacent to the structure as estimated from available elevation data.

table:columns.name: FIPS
table:columns.description: US County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code (5 digit).

table:columns.name: CENSUSCODE
table:columns.description: Census tract identifier; a concatenation of current state Federal Information Processing Series (FIPS) code, county FIPS code, and census tract code.

table:columns.name: PROD_DATE
table:columns.description: The date that the structure/feature was captured using automated methods (MM/DD/YYYY).

table:columns.name: SOURCE
table:columns.description: This is the name of the contractor or the government agency that created the feature.

table:columns.name: USNG
table:columns.description: United States National Grid Coordinate.

table:columns.name: LONGITUDE
table:columns.description: Longitude of located point on centroid of structure in millionths of decimal degrees.

table:columns.name: LATITUDE
table:columns.description: Latitude of located point on centroid of structure in millionths of decimal degrees.

table:columns.name: IMAGE_NAME
table:columns.description: The catalog ID from the Maxar commercial imagery, or the name of the image from National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP) imagery used to extract structures. LiDAR-derived footprints provided by the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency (NGA). For LiDAR-derived footprints, the first portion of the name ('LiXXX') denotes the Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) production code while the latter portion is the city/project covered.

table:columns.name: IMAGE_DATE
table:columns.description: This is the date of the imagery or LiDAR from which the building outline was captured (MM/DD/YYYY).

table:columns.name: VAL_METHOD
table:columns.description: Methodology used to validate building outline as a true positive.

table:columns.name: REMARKS
table:columns.description: This is comments that cannot be captured by existing data fields.

table:columns.name: UUID
table:columns.description: Universally Unique Identifier (method 4); a 128-bit id label coded in hexadecimal as a string in '{8-4-4-4-12}' or '8-4-4-4-12' format. Each structure within the complete USA Structures database will have a unique UUID. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4122.html

table:columns.name: B_CODE
table:columns.description: Name of building code standard likely in effect during construction.

table:columns.name: POP_CI95_UPPER
table:columns.description: Upper bound (percentile 97.5) of 95% Coverage Interval on building population estimate.

table:columns.name: POP_MEDIAN
table:columns.description: Median (percentile 50) building population estimate.

table:columns.name: POP_CI95_LOWER
table:columns.description: Lower bound (percentile 2.5) of 95% Coverage Interval on building population estimate.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Building footprint, WKB-encoded.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Footprint bounding box (GeoParquet 1.1 covering column) for bbox filtering.
